summary: The smoke particles of the explosion are displayed when Particles option is set to minimal
description:
What I expected to happen was...:

 After the explosion of TNT its particles will not appear.

What actually happened was...:

 After the explosion, the particles appear and the game lags (on slow computers).

Steps to reproduce:

 - Set the Particles option to "Minimum"

 - Ignite TNT
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft and create a Creative world with default settings.
2. Open Options -> Video Settings.
3. Set the Particles option to "Minimum."
4. Return to the world and ignite TNT.
5. Wait until the TNT explodes.
6. Observe that smoke particles appear after the explosion and that the game lags on slow computers.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.8.8, 15w47c, 15w49a, 15w49b, 1.8.9, 15w50a, 15w51a, 15w51b, 16w02a, 16w03a, 16w04a, 16w05a, 16w05b, 16w06a, 16w07a, 1.9 Pre-Release 1, 1.9 Pre-Release 2, 1.9 Pre-Release 3, 1.9 Pre-Release 4, 1.9, 1.9.1 Pre-Release 1, 1.9.1 Pre-Release 2, 1.9.1 Pre-Release 3, 1.9.2, 16w14a, 16w15a, 16w15b, 1.9.3 Pre-Release 1, 1.9.3 Pre-Release 3, 1.9.3, 1.9.4, 16w20a, 16w21b, 1.10.2, 16w33a, 16w35a, 16w36a, 16w38a, 16w39a, 16w40a, 16w41a, 1.11, 1.11.2, 17w06a, 17w14a, 17w15a, 17w16a, 17w16b, 17w17a, 17w17b, 17w18a, 17w18b, 1.12 Pre-Release 1, 1.12 Pre-Release 2, 1.12 Pre-Release 3, 1.12 Pre-Release 4, 1.12 Pre-Release 5, 1.12 Pre-Release 6, 1.12 Pre-Release 7, 1.12, 1.12.1 Pre-Release 1, 1.12.1, 1.12.2 Pre-Release 1, 1.12.2 Pre-Release 2, 1.12.2, 17w43a, 17w43b, 17w45a, 17w45b, 17w46a, 17w47a, 17w47b, 17w48a, 17w50a, 18w21a, 1.13-pre6, 1.13, 18w30b, 1.13.1, 1.13.2, 18w45a, 18w46a, 1.14.4, 19w34a, 19w37a, 19w39a, 19w42a, 19w46b (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: After the TNT detonates, explosion smoke particles are still rendered even though the Particles setting is set to **Minimal**. A large number of these particles may be visible and can cause noticeable performance degradation, particularly on slower computers.
Expected Behavior: With the Particles setting set to “Minimum,” igniting TNT should still cause the explosion normally, but its explosion smoke particles should not be rendered. No explosion particle effect should appear after detonation, and the game should avoid the unnecessary performance impact caused by displaying those particles, particularly on slower computers.
